extraction.teacher_style: The instructor teaches Pantsula dance fundamentals in a structured manner, breaking down each step while demonstrating with backup dancers. He uses a mix of verbal explanations, counts, and practice counts to guide learners through combinations.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces himself and the class topic
Teacher leads a warmup with backup dancers
Teacher breaks down the first move called Spharaphara
Teacher breaks down the second move called Shuffle
Teacher breaks down the Pantsula proof move

metaphors: It is a connection between one move and another
common_mistakes: Not hearing the sound of the step harder on the floor

steps_taught.name: Spharaphara

steps_taught.name: Shuffle
steps_taught.description: Stepping forward, back, and returning to shuffle position

steps_taught.name: Pantsula Proof
steps_taught.description: A combination of kicks and twists with arm and wrist movements
